title: Lior and the Sigil
author: S. M. Okonkwo
blurb: Oscar Kavanagh, a royal food-taster building immunity one dish at a time, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
